name: nz-company-register-core
description: Use for selected New Zealand domestic company incorporation prerequisites and the separate Companies Office annual return. Trigger on company name reservation, director or shareholder consents, registered office, address for service or Companies Register annual returns. Requires a confirmed ordinary company limited by shares, current primary law and independently established eligibility and the applicable prescribed return information. Supplies a bounded register checklist and missing-evidence controls; it cannot complete entity selection, reporting or audit classification, tax registration decisions or a filing without qualified review.
